critical_code_review_comments: In-memory _sync_previews / _csv_previews dicts in routes/admin_players.py are process-local; behind multi-worker gunicorn/uvicorn a dry-run on worker A followed by apply on worker B would 410. Acceptable for a single-worker preview env, but should move to Mongo TTL collection or Redis once we scale workers.

POST /admin/players/sync makes real HTTPX calls to api-web.nhle.com during dry-run; a slow / rate-limited NHL response would block the FastAPI worker for the fetch duration. Consider a background task + status endpoint for full 32-team syncs (partial teams like TOR+MTL are fine at ~300ms).
seed_data_creation: Live test used TEST_-prefixed player rows (auto-cleaned in fixtures). NHL dry-run touched no DB rows.
